## [0.29.0](https://github.com/BeppeTemp/cartographer/compare/v0.28.0...v0.29.0) (2026-11-17)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **mcp:** sync_apply is gone from the tool registry, the policy classes, the advanced-tool list and the local-only authorizer
* **mcp:** the sync_apply MCP tool is removed; materialize with `cartographer sync` on the machine whose files they are.
* **client:** remove the TUI dashboard; bare cartographer prints a short status and the usage

### Atlas

#### Features

* a Components view lists what is deployed, its runs, alarms and protocol skew (3a6f4ca)
* a Draft report action on the Surveyor's report candidates (f350b48)
* a plugin declares read-only views and external-app entries as data (1bf6cde)
* a Plugins tab in Settings with each component's approval state (7fe59ff)
* a rail group of plugin views and external-app links, four fixed renderers (78e23f4)
* clusters are drawn as sized super-nodes and unfold on click or zoom (c0f0ceb, closes #1962)
* Health built on components and maintenance (e40088a)
* large KBs open as a mixed graph of cluster super-nodes and plain concepts (53444e3)
* Surveyor sources in Settings, runs in Activity only when there are runs (af84a1f)
* the Atlas loads the clustered graph above the threshold and keeps its unfold set (2782111, closes #1962)
* the Atlas names Meridian and Compass (0a02203)
* the Atlas tour covers the Surveyor tab and a Surveyor-at-work animation is recorded (52689d6)
* the No remote indicator names the kb attach command (abf686e)
* the server loads the atlas side of pinned plugins and refuses a view that is not over a public GET route (a4405be)
* the worker's settings in the Settings page (#1413, ce834c9)
* workers, feeds in error and who maintains the KB (#1411, f52022f)

#### Bug Fixes

* a transition interrupted by another starts from what is drawn (165e80b, closes #2081)
* the Atlas source hash lists tracked files with a clean git environment (d511dd6)
* the release history tests no longer boot the whole app to test one sheet (34983be, closes #1899)
* the Surveyor tour opens the collapsed day before expecting the perimeter (b7d534a, closes #2103)
* the Surveyors tab stops polling while the page is hidden (ff9ceb3)

### MCP tools

#### Features

* a bridge can ask for the operating guide in initialize (120ecfc, closes #1805)
* a clustered graph route cached by generation and visibility (79e1ae8)
* a component route refuses a token of the wrong kind (3951a18)
* a CORS allow-list for the read API (fcd3dfd)
* a descriptor can declare the network it requires (a497e72, closes #1911)
* a hook registry decides by breaker, failure policy and dry-run (357e531)
* a leaf package names the component routes, kinds, states and the N/N-1 rule (76e456f)
* a public read-only /api/v1 behind api.enabled (aaf3983)
* a registry of expected components, with expected-but-silent as a health state (23e0585)
* a removedTools table beside legacyToolMessage points a caller of a removed tool at its replacement (c565b9a)
* a resumable per-KB event stream (1d79529)
* a role rule can withhold secrets (c670d5a)
* a secret reference can be resolved by a hook (1162c2c)
* a token can be bound to an approved plugin as its service identity (d7f4a46)
* a token carries a kind and an optional expiry, enforced by the store (1d14bda)
* a trusted proxy supplies the user and groups, mapped to roles under the proxy token's ceiling (74914c5)
* a versioned HTTP webhook transport with timeout, failure policy, breaker and dry-run (d19a018)
* a write can be vetoed by a hook, outside the KB lock (12f06cd)
* an identity hook lists the request headers it is handed (headers, at most 8, never Authorization or Proxy-Authorization) (30ff64c)
* an internal-error result carries a fixed hint that a report can be offered (642dc12)
* an OpenAPI document generated from the routes, with a contract test (650adef)
* bound the range read with MaxRangeCommits (5,000), past which it answers ErrRangeTooLarge (2002896)
* cartographer mcp exec starts a descriptor with its secrets in the child environment (08888ac, closes #1911)
* descriptors take env_literal and ${secret:} references (d5962b1)
* emit the launcher for secret references and for clients without header support (34eb8b0, closes #1911)
* kb_repair check auto runs the same staged repair as the timer (d275ce5)
* kb_review reports an old ID still cited after a concept_move (06d1df2)
* kb_status gives the Atlas link of its KB when the server serves it (0feafda, closes #1945)
* mcp exec bridges stdio to an HTTP descriptor with headers (4967d59, closes #1911)
* mcp probe resolves variables and classifies network and TLS errors (fa660b5, closes #1911)
* mcp probe runs initialize and tools/list as the client would (95a12a9, closes #1911)
* Meridian accepts and exposes the recent runs and alarms of a Surveyor (ca9d41f)
* Meridian keeps bounded report candidates and builds a redacted draft (b1e6a28)
* plugins pinned by digest in the server and Surveyor configs (9df8728)
* preset_list hands an approved preset to an authorised writer (1e22506)
* records carry the principal kind and the token behind an identity (a89ffc6)
* reload tokens and roles without restart (7935458)
* resolve an approved descriptor and its secrets for a launch (087d0cf, closes #1911)
* secrets_init writes and commits the KB's .sops.yaml (5345b79, closes #1911)
* sources array with origin, kind and last check on the Surveyor settings report (73308d5)
* the audit chain is delivered to a sink, replayable from a cursor (cc40c70)
* the audit log can be read after a cursor, with a wake-up on append (bd481f0)
* the heartbeat carries the task kinds the Surveyor runs (0a3ba84)
* the server config declares hooks and builds their registry at start (583b5c6)
* the server pauses its background repair for a KB a live Surveyor repairs (6320ec7)
* the token middleware exposes a re-check and OpenAPI describes event streams (404f0ee)
* worker heartbeat, per-KB idle signal and artifact-write denial (#1404, be6aaa0)

#### Bug Fixes

* a KB that cannot be mounted at start is skipped and reported, not fatal (2d09c74, closes #1963)
* a multi-check kb_repair dry run lints the KB once (54c7ae7, closes #2070)
* a push that does not leave is visible in status, doctor and the tray (e81d035, closes #1964)
* advertise ingest_setup in the agent tools/list (ec2769f, closes #1942)
* artifact_write refuses an agent whose frontmatter is not valid YAML (57c54d3, closes #1984)

* source_register returns its content_hash, and served texts name only tools a client can call (04728c7, closes #2145 #2146 #2147)
* the Atlas KB list and doctor read secrets state live, like kb_status (a84002f, closes #2150)
* the write gate refuses a page in an undeclared map, gate_check applies one contradiction rule (9683522, closes #2185)

### Server & KB

#### Features

* a key file added to credentials_dir loads without a restart (034b1a1)
* generate an OKF documentation KB from docs/ (d69323d)
* link the generated documentation KB and gate it in the build (0f5a0ad)

#### Bug Fixes

* a concept read on Windows retries a sharing violation (57651e0, closes #2077)
* a declined push is called an identity refusal only when the remote names the identity (c1c5013, closes #2151)
* a push the remote refuses for good fails at once, and server commits ignore the user's git config (ef35ec2, closes #1965)
* a refused write leaves no git object behind (98119ff, closes #2186)
* a transient read error no longer drops a concept from the graph (4678342, closes #2016)
* a write whose commit fails fails the call and restores the tree (fc03482, closes #2190)
* asset_list skips symlinks, asset errors carry no server path (0f5f87e, closes #2191)
* clear a leftover index.lock at server start and name a later one (db08c94, closes #1997)
* fail a push refused for its credentials at once instead of retrying it (2f2d97c, closes #1996)
* FlushPush no longer returns while a write signalled mid-push is unpushed (f8157af, closes #1856)
* git failures never carry the credentials of any remote of the clone (e724a20)
* kb create --remote refuses a remote that carries a credential (b7cc122, closes #1851)
* remote output quoted in an error or a sync status is sanitized and bounded (2ed83f1)
* search excerpts are cut in Go from a bounded prefix and stop with the request (c2205c9, closes #2189)
* the async push tests wait for a push as long as a loaded host needs (cd38a51, closes #2212)
